audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors: the page calls Frost Armor a shield ('her passive shielding', 'Frost Armor makes her a wall'), and it claims Permafrost cancels Locke's E dash mid-animation.
audit.why: Riot's text for Fury of the North grants Armor, Magic Resist and immunity to slows — no shield, so it does not absorb your burst, it resists it. Slow immunity is the interaction that actually matters and was never stated: while Frost Armor holds, your Q slow and your R slow do nothing to her. Permafrost is a 1.5s-cooldown point-and-click stun gated on maximum Frost stacks; whether a stun interrupts Locke's E mid-dash is not in either kit file and is unverifiable here.
audit.corrected: Shield language replaced with the real resistances plus slow immunity; the dash-cancel claim removed and replaced with the Frost-stack gate and the 1.5s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Arctic Assault's 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s cooldown was never given a number even though the whole page tells you to commit on it.
audit.why: 'Track it' is unactionable without the length of the window.
audit.corrected: Left the full layer alone (it is at length) and stated the Frost-stack gate concretely in spikes[0] instead.

edits.before: Sejuani's level-1 Frost Armor shrugs off your on-hit pressure entirely.
edits.after: Frost Armor's armour, MR and slow immunity blank your level-1 poke.

edits.before: Level 3 Permafrost stun cancels your E dash and locks down any trade.
edits.after: Level 3 Permafrost stuns off full Frost stacks and ends any trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 her passive shielding and stun deny every all-in you attempt.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 her Frost Armor resistances and stun deny every all-in.

edits.before: Sejuani's Frost Armor passive plus Arctic Assault (Q) charge gives her a tanky engage that shrugs off your burst; her Permafrost (E) stun off Frost stacks locks you down and cancels your E dash, so never fight into a stacked target.
edits.after: Sejuani's Frost Armor grants free armour, MR and slow immunity — your Q slow does nothing while it holds; her Permafrost (E) then stuns on a 1.5-second cooldown once Winter's Wrath fills your Frost stacks, so never fight a stacked bar.

edits.before: At 6 Glacial Prison (R) is a long-range flash-stun that hard-CCs you before you can set up Purgatory; her tankiness also means she rarely drops low enough for the totem to execute in a straight fight.
edits.after: At 6 Glacial Prison (R) is a 1300-range stun that locks you before Purgatory lands; your own R grounds, so it denies Arctic Assault — but her tankiness keeps her above the execute floor in a straight fight.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 Sejuani already wins: Frost Armor makes her a wall your Silver Stake on-hit can't crack, and Arctic Assault (Q) lets her charge in and apply Frost stacks toward a stun. You do zero meaningful damage to her health bar, so just farm at range and treat every step forward as stun-bait.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 Sejuani already wins: Frost Armor hands her armour, MR and slow immunity, so your on-hit chip and your Q slow both bounce, and Arctic Assault (Q) knocks you up to start the Frost stacks. You do little meaningful damage to her bar, so farm at range and treat every step forward as stun-bait.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 she owns the lane. Once she has Permafrost (E) up, any Frost-stacked target eats a point-and-click stun that cancels your E reset dash mid-animation, and her passive shielding means your all-in fizzles. At 6 Glacial Prison adds a long-range lockdown. There's no trade window here — farm, ping for jungle pressure, and don't feed her engage.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 she owns the lane. Once Permafrost (E) is up, a fully Frost-stacked target eats a point-and-click stun on a 1.5-second cooldown, and Frost Armor's armour and MR mean your all-in fizzles into resistances. At 6 Glacial Prison adds a long-range lockdown. There's no trade window here — farm, ping for jungle pressure, and don't feed her engage.

edits.before: Arctic Assault (Q) engage into your dash to cancel your E
edits.after: Arctic Assault (Q) knockup to open her Frost stack chain

notes: Fury of the North is not a shield — it is armour, MR and slow immunity. The slow immunity is the real, previously-unstated interaction: Locke's Q slow and R slow are both dead while Frost Armor is up. I removed the 'Permafrost cancels your E dash' claim rather than restating it: stun-versus-dash priority is not in Riot's text and cannot be verified from the kit files, and the mirror audit flagged the same claim.
